events.result:
Batch 3 migrated, 40 records (120 migrated so far).
Validation note: the old CRM stored phone numbers without country codes. The new CRM
assumed every number was domestic and saved it with a +1 prefix. 31 of the 120
records migrated so far belong to overseas customers, so their phone numbers in the
new CRM are wrong. Records from batches 4 to 10 will have the same problem.
New CRM activity: 14 sales users have opened customer records in the last 24 hours.

args.body: Migration paused after batch 3: 120 of 400 records migrated. Validation reports that the new CRM incorrectly added +1 to 31 overseas customers’ phone numbers; batches 4–10 would have the same issue. Sales users are already accessing records (14 users in the last 24 hours), so affected numbers may be relied on. Please alert the sales team and authorize a correction using verified country codes, plus resolution of the import default before migration resumes. No phone corrections have been made; 280 records remain unmigrated.
